responsibility: Builds GCC tree type descriptors for runtime data structures shared with libgcobol and provides helper accessors for their fields. It defines the front end’s tree types for cblc_field_t, cblc_file_t, enabled-exception records, and related pointer forms, plus member/member2/member3 helpers that generate tree references and assignments to structure members during code generation.
same_name_distinction: Builds the GCC tree type nodes and member-access helpers for libgcobol runtime structs at compile time. The paired header only advertises those tree nodes and helper functions for use by other generators.
